title: Hide swap sensors when swap is not available
line: On systems without swap, the System Monitor sensor picker no longer lists Swap Memory sensors.
explanation: ksystemstats' memory plugin always created the Swap Memory sensor object, so its sensors were listed in every sensor picker even on systems with no swap, where they can only read zero. Separately, SensorContainer::removeObject cleared the object's container before emitting objectRemoved, so ksystemstats sent sensorRemoved with paths like "/total" instead of "memory/swap/total" and clients never dropped removed sensors (this also affected unplugged disks, network devices and batteries). The memory plugin now adds the swap object only while sysinfo() reports swap, re-checking every update so swapon/swapoff are followed live, and libksysguard emits objectRemoved before clearing the container so removals reach clients.

commits.message:
plugins/memory: only list swap sensors when the system has swap

On systems without swap the Swap Memory sensors were always listed in
the sensor picker even though they can only ever read zero. Now the swap
object is only added while swap is available, following swapon/swapoff.

BUG: 462707

systemstats: emit objectRemoved before clearing the object's container

The object's container was cleared before objectRemoved was emitted, so
the sensorRemoved paths that ksystemstats derives from it were missing
the container and clients never dropped those sensors. Clear it after.

BUG: 462707

From 013430a22f42a2002ecfbfd037398fd7387168bc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:58:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] systemstats: emit objectRemoved before clearing the object's
 container

The object's container was cleared before objectRemoved was emitted, so
the sensorRemoved paths that ksystemstats derives from it were missing
the container and clients never dropped those sensors. Clear it after.

BUG: 462707
---
 systemstats/SensorContainer.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/systemstats/SensorContainer.cpp b/systemstats/SensorContainer.cpp
index 28c811b4..6c0b3339 100644
--- a/systemstats/SensorContainer.cpp
+++ b/systemstats/SensorContainer.cpp
@@ -82,7 +82,7 @@ void SensorContainer::removeObject(SensorObject *object)
         return;
     }
 
-    object->setParentContainer(nullptr);
     d->sensorObjects.remove(object->id());
     Q_EMIT objectRemoved(object);
+    object->setParentContainer(nullptr);
 }
